Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Slip Sliding Away]]: the picture sleeve of Paul Simon's 1977 single "Slip Slidin' Away" (CBS 5770).

Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Paulsimon_slipslidinaway77.jpg Paulsimon slipslidinaway77.jpg], English Wikipedia (316 by 315 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026211629/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Paulsimon_slipslidinaway77.jpg Internet Archive], 26 October 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a low-resolution copy (316 by 315 pixels) of the 1977 record sleeve, © its rights holders, shown to identify the song the card's title refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
